subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama `timeoutSeconds` become an idle/no-progress timeout while streamed chunks arrive, matching sibling streaming transports even though current docs describe a total guarded-fetch abort?
rationale: The code change is small and likely correct, but it changes an existing timeout contract and the review cannot safely decide the compatibility policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require proof and contract alignment
options.body: Ask for redacted remote/slow Ollama proof and align the docs or PR body with the accepted idle-timeout contract before merge.

options.title: Accept the behavior as-is
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept sibling parity now and leave any broader docs cleanup to follow-up work.

options.title: Reject the semantic change
options.body: Close or redirect the PR if Ollama `timeoutSeconds` must remain a total wall-clock stream cap.

recommendation.title: Require proof and contract alignment
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted remote/slow Ollama proof and align the docs or PR body with the accepted idle-timeout contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current and recent Ollama stream history makes this the strongest available owner for the timeout semantics choice.
